items.title: Semaglutide for Treating Paediatric Craniopharyngioma-Related Obesity: A Multicentre Case Series.
items.abstract:
AIMS: Obesity is a complication of childhood craniopharyngioma that remains difficult to treat. We investigated whether semaglutide was associated with a decrease in BMI among adolescents with craniopharyngioma-related obesity.
MATERIAL AND METHODS: This multicentre retrospective study included 20 patients < 18 years old with craniopharyngioma and obesity (BMI > 2 WHO Z-score) from 2019 to 2024 (source population: 139 children with craniopharyngioma, including 36 children with obesity). They received off-label semaglutide with dose titration (0.25-2 mg/week), tailored to tolerance and clinical response. The primary outcome was the within-patient comparison of BMI change from -12 months to treatment initiation and from initiation to +12 months.
RESULTS: At semaglutide initiation, patients were 14.0 ± 3.9 years old, the interval since craniopharyngioma diagnosis was 6.3 ± 4.7 years, and BMI was 33.4 ± 3.9 kg/m2 (3.2 ± 0.7 Z-score). Tumour treatment was surgery alone (8/20), surgery and proton therapy (11/20), or proton therapy alone (1/20). All patients had growth hormone and TSH deficiency; 19/20 had ACTH and AVP deficiency. In the year before treatment, patients gained 3.5 ± 4.4 kg/m2 in BMI and 0.6 ± 1.6 in BMI Z-score; after 1 year of semaglutide therapy, they lost 2.5 ± 3.9 kg/m2 in BMI and 0.5 ± 0.5 in BMI Z-score (paired comparisons, p < 0.001 and p = 0.004, respectively). During treatment, BMI decreased by 10% or more in 40% of patients (95% CI: 19%-64%). Gastrointestinal side effects occurred in 30% of patients but were mild. No cases of treatment discontinuation, pituitary insufficiency decompensation or tumour recurrence were observed.
CONCLUSIONS: Semaglutide was associated with reversal of weight gain among adolescents with craniopharyngioma-related obesity.
items.authors: Dornberger Joanne, Barat Pascal, Aouchiche Karine, Perge Kevin, Villanueva Carine, Castets Sarah, Bouhours-Nouet Natacha, Donzeau Aurelie
items.summary_ja: 小児頭蓋咽頭腫関連肥満は治療が困難な合併症である。本多施設後ろ向き研究では、2019年から2024年にかけて、頭蓋咽頭腫を合併し肥満（BMI > 2 WHO Z-score）を有する18歳未満の20例を対象に、オフラベルのセマグルチド（0.25〜2 mg/週、用量漸増）のBMIへの影響を評価した。主要アウトカムは、治療開始前12ヶ月から開始時、および開始時から+12ヶ月までのBMI変化の患者内比較であった。治療開始時、患者の平均年齢は14.0±3.9歳、BMIは33.4±3.9 kg/m²（3.2±0.7 Z-score）であった。治療前1年間でBMIは3.5±4.4 kg/m²増加したが、セマグルチド投与1年後にはBMIが2.5±3.9 kg/m²、BMI Z-scoreが0.5±0.5減少した（対比較、p<0.001、p=0.004）。40%の患者でBMIが10%以上減少した（95% CI: 19%〜64%）。消化管副作用は30%で軽度であり、治療中断、下垂体機能不全の失代償、腫瘍再発は観察されなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチドは、頭蓋咽頭腫関連肥満を有する思春期患者において体重増加の反転と関連した。
items.why_matters_ja: 小児頭蓋咽頭腫に伴う肥満は治療が困難な合併症であり、本ケースシリーズはセマグルチドのオフラベル使用における有効性と安全性の初期証拠を提供する。

items.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：治療開始前12ヶ月から開始時、および開始時から+12ヶ月までのBMI変化の患者内比較

items.title: Indirect comparative efficacy and safety of tirzepatide vs semaglutide for the treatment of obesity or overweight in patients without type 2 diabetes.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: Tirzepatide is a once-weekly, glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist (RA) for obesity treatment. This indirect treatment comparison (ITC) assessed the relative efficacy and safety of tirzepatide versus the GLP-1 RA semaglutide.
SUBJECTS/METHODS: Adjusted (for sex, and sex and ethnicity) and unadjusted ITCs compared tirzepatide 5, 10, and 15 mg/week and semaglutide 2.4 mg/week via placebo, all adjunct to reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity, at primary trial endpoints (Week 68, STEP 1; Week 72, SURMOUNT-1) for adults with obesity (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2), or overweight (BMI ≥ 27 kg/m2) with ≥1 obesity-related complication (ORC), without type 2 diabetes (T2D).
RESULTS: For efficacy estimand unadjusted ITCs, tirzepatide 10 and 15 mg demonstrated statistically significant improvements versus semaglutide in weight reduction (-5.10 kg [-6.63, - 3.57], -6.50 kg [-8.03,-4.97]), participants achieving ≥10/15/20% weight reduction, BMI (-1.87 kg/m2 [-2.43,-1.31], -2.37 kg/m2 [-2.93,-1.81]), waist circumference (-5.25 cm [-6.69,-3.81], -5.75 cm [-7.19,-4.31]), HbA1c(-0.08% [-0.13,-0.03], -0.10% [-0.15, -0.05]) and fasting plasma glucose (-1.69 mg/dL [-3.36,-0.02], -2.52 mg/dL [-4.19,-0.85]). Tirzepatide 5 mg showed non-significant trends of greater improvements in these outcomes versus semaglutide. All tirzepatide doses showed statistically significantly greater decreases in diastolic blood pressure (-1.90 mmHg [-3.19,-0.61], -2.40 mmHg [-3.69,-1.11], -1.30 mmHg [-2.59,-0.01]) and increases in HDL (3.80% [1.23,6.37], 5.40% [2.83,7.97], 5.00% [2.43,7.57]). In participants reporting on body composition, tirzepatide 15 mg demonstrated statistically significant improvements in body composition versus semaglutide, with a reduction of percentage body fat mass (-3.50% [-6.66, -0.34]) and an increase of percentage body lean mass (3.40% [0.40, 6.40]). Results were broadly consistent across adjusted and unadjusted comparisons. Safety profiles of tirzepatide and semaglutide were generally similar.
CONCLUSIONS: In this ITC for obesity treatment in adults without T2D, with obesity, or overweight with ≥1 ORC, compared with semaglutide, tirzepatide 10 or 15 mg was associated with improvements in weight reduction, body composition and several cardiometabolic risk factors and generally similar safety profiles.

items.title: Targeting the aldosterone-mineralocorticoid receptor pathway in cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic syndrome.
items.abstract: The concept of cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome integrates cardiovascular, kidney and metabolic disorders into a single pathophysiological continuum characterized by chronic inflammation, oxidative stress, fibrosis and progressive organ dysfunction. A central driver of CKM syndrome progression is inappropriate activation of the aldosterone-mineralocorticoid receptor (MR) pathway, which promotes adverse remodelling of the heart, kidney, vasculature, adipose tissue, liver and pancreas. Steroidal MR antagonists (MRAs) and non-steroidal MRAs mitigate maladaptive MR signalling and improve cardiorenal outcomes. Compared with steroidal MRAs, non-steroidal MRAs such as finerenone provide enhanced tissue selectivity and favourable safety profiles. Finerenone has been shown to reduce cardiovascular and renal events in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and in patients with heart failure. Aldosterone synthase inhibitors represent a complementary approach that suppresses aldosterone production upstream of MR activation and has shown promising results in resistant hypertension and CKD. Preclinical and clinical data indicate that combined strategies targeting the aldosterone-MR axis can attenuate cardiorenal remodelling, insulin resistance and organ injury, offering a comprehensive therapeutic approach. Ongoing trials will clarify the efficacy of these combined therapies in non-diabetic CKD, resistant hypertension and broader CKM syndrome populations. Overall, targeting the aldosterone-MR pathway represents a central strategy to reduce organ dysfunction, improve metabolic homeostasis and limit progression of CKM syndrome.
items.authors: Sánchez-Bayuela Tania, Barrera-Chimal Jonatan, Jaisser Frederic
items.summary_ja: 心血管・腎・代謝（CKM）症候群は、慢性炎症・酸化ストレス・線維化・進行性臓器障害を特徴とする単一の病生理学的連続体として心血管・腎・代謝疾患を統合する概念である。CKM症候群の進行の中心的な駆動因子は、アルドステロン-ミネラルコルチコイド受容体（MR）経路の不適切な活性化であり、心臓・腎臓・血管・脂肪組織・肝臓・膵臓の有害なリモデリングを促進する。ステロイド系MR拮抗薬（MRA）および非ステロイド系MRAは不適切なMRシグナルを軽減し、心腎アウトカムを改善する。非ステロイド系MRA（フィネレノン）はステロイド系MRAと比較して組織選択性が高く、安全性プロファイルが良好である。フィネレノンは慢性腎臓病（CKD）患者および心不全患者において心血管イベントおよび腎イベントを減少させることが示されている。アルドステロンシンターゼ阻害薬はMR活性化の上流でアルドステロン産生を抑制する補完的アプローチであり、抵抗性高血圧およびCKDで有望な結果を示している。前臨床および臨床データは、アルドステロン-MR軸を標的とする複合戦略が心腎リモデリング、インスリン抵抗性、臓器障害を軽減しうることを示唆している。進行中の試験が、非糖尿病CKD、抵抗性高血圧、より広いCKM症候群集団におけるこれらの複合療法の有効性を明確にする。
items.key_takeaway_ja: アルドステロン-MR経路を標的とすることは、臓器障害の軽減、代謝恒常性の改善、CKM症候群の進行抑制のための中心的戦略である。
items.why_matters_ja: CKM症候群は心血管・腎・代謝疾患を単一の病生理学的連続体として統合し、アルドステロン-MR経路の不適切な活性化がその進行の中心的な駆動因子である。この経路を標的とする治療戦略（MRA、アルドステロンシンターゼ阻害薬、複合戦略）は、多臓器障害の軽減と代謝恒常性の改善に寄与しうる。

items.title: Safety profile of finerenone: Pooled analysis of different types of arrhythmic events.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Finerenone reduces kidney and cardiovascular events in patients with chronic kidney disease and type 2 diabetes mellitus, but its safety profile in terms of arrhythmic outcomes remains uncertain.
METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, Cochrane Library, and ClinicalTrials.gov (inception-March 2026) for randomized trials reporting arrhythmias or conduction disorders with finerenone versus control. Risk ratios (RRs) were pooled using fixed-effects models; heterogeneity was assessed with I2.
RESULTS: Six trials (21,015 patients; mean age 67.2 years; 33.9% women) were included. Finerenone was not associated with increased atrial or ventricular arrhythmias, high-grade atrioventricular block, or cardiac arrest (all RRs non-significant; low heterogeneity).
CONCLUSIONS: Finerenone shows no clear increase in clinically reported arrhythmic events in the pooled analysis; however, the included studies were not designed to assess the rate of arrhythmic outcomes and might have underestimated the true rates.
items.authors: Bazoukis George, Clarke Esther Victoria, Tse Gary
items.summary_ja: フィネレノンの不整脈イベントに関する安全性プロファイルを評価するため、PubMed、Cochrane Library、ClinicalTrials.govからランダム化試験を体系的に検索し、フィネレノン対対照群での不整脈または伝導障害を報告した6試験（21,015例）をプール解析した。固定効果モデルでリスク比（RR）をプールし、I²で異質性を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: フィネレノンは心房性不整脈、心室性不整脈、高度房室ブロック、心停止のいずれにおいても有意な増加を示さなかった（全RR有意差なし、低異質性）。ただし、対象試験は不整脈アウトカムの評価を目的として設計されておらず、真の発生率を過小評価している可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: フィネレノンは慢性腎臓病を伴う2型糖尿病患者で腎・心血管イベントを減少させるが、不整脈に関する安全性プロファイルは不確実であった。本プール解析により、臨床的に報告された不整脈イベントの明確な増加がないことが示された。

items.title: Peer Referral Pathways and 6-Month Outcomes in a Tirzepatide-Supported Digital Weight Loss Service: Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.abstract: In a retrospective analysis of 34,449 adults using an unsubsidized, tirzepatide-supported digital weight loss service (DWLS) in Australia, patients entering via peer referral showed higher 6-month program adherence and greater percentage weight loss than propensity score-matched nonreferred patients, suggesting that peer referral pathways may support retention and effectiveness in medicated obesity care.
items.authors: Talay Louis, Swinckels Laura, Hom Jason, Tan Marilyn, Ahuja Neera
items.summary_ja: オーストラリアの非補助型tirzepatide併用デジタル減量サービス（DWLS）を利用した34,449人の成人を対象とした後方視的コホート研究。ピア紹介経由で入会した患者は、傾向スコアマッチングによる非紹介患者と比較して、6ヶ月間のプログラム継続率が高く、体重減少率も大きかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: ピア紹介経路は、薬剤併用肥満治療における患者の継続率と減量効果の向上に関連する可能性がある。
items.why_matters_ja: 薬剤併用肥満治療のデジタルサービスにおいて、ピア紹介という低コストの介入が患者の定着と治療効果に寄与し得ることを示唆し、サービス設計や患者エンゲージメント戦略に示唆を与える。

items.title: New Amylin-Based Agonists for the Treatment of Obesity and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and obesity represent two major global health challenges. Amylin-based agonists offer a promising perspective. Three frontrunner agents of this class are increasingly being investigated: zenagamtide, eloralintide and cagrilintide-semaglutide (CagriSema).
METHODS: A search in PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus and Google Scholar was conducted with the use of appropriate keywords until June 2026 for this narrative review.
RESULTS: Zenagamtide (formerly known as amycretin), a unimolecular long-lasting amylin and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor (GLP-1R) co-agonist, achieved weight loss up to 13.1% (phase 1 study, 85 days) in obesity trials as an oral formulation and up to 24.3% (phase 1b/2a study, 36 weeks) as a subcutaneous formulation. Moreover, eloralintide, a long-acting mostly amylin type 1 receptor (AMY1R) agonist, achieved weight loss up to 20.1% (phase 2 study, 48 weeks), and CagriSema resulted in weight loss up to 22.7% (phase 3a study, 68 weeks). All these agents reduced body mass index (BMI) and waist circumference (WC). In T2DM, CagriSema reduced glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) by up to 2.0% (trial product estimand, phase 3a study, 68 weeks) and is currently the most well-studied agent in T2DM. In treatment-naïve people with T2DM, this agent has been successfully used, leading even to T2DM remission in approximately one out of two CagriSema users (phase 3a, 40 weeks). In individuals with T2DM receiving basal insulin, it reduced insulin dose by 20 units compared with the control arm (phase 3a, 40 weeks). The safety profile of amycretin and CagriSema is overall consistent with that of glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs). Preliminary evidence suggests that eloralintide, as an AMY1R monoagonist, was associated with a distinct adverse events profile, including fatigue, headache and appetite loss.
CONCLUSIONS: These agents hold therapeutic potential in the management of both T2DM and obesity, as shown by preliminary clinical trial outcomes. Further trials are now needed to validate them in clinical practice.
items.journal: Diabetes therapy : research, treatment and education of diabetes and related disorders
items.authors: Panou Theodoros, Gouveri Evanthia, Popovic Djordje S, Papanas Nikolaos
items.summary_ja: 本論文は、肥満および2型糖尿病（T2DM）の治療におけるアミリンベースのagonist（zenagamtide、eloralintide、CagriSema）に関するナラティブレビューである。PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Google Scholarを用いて2026年6月まで検索を実施した。zenagamtideは経口投与で最大13.1%（第1相、85日）、皮下投与で最大24.3%（第1b/2a相、36週間）の減量を達成し、eloralintideは最大20.1%（第2相、48週間）、CagriSemaは最大22.7%（第3a相、68週間）の減量を達成した。T2DMにおいてCagriSemaはHbA1cを最大2.0%低下させ（第3a相、68週間）、治療経験のないT2DM患者では約半数にT2DM寛解を達成し（第3a相、40週間）、基礎インスリン併用患者では対照群比でインスリン用量を20単位減少させた（第3a相、40週間）。
items.key_takeaway_ja: アミリンベースのagonist（zenagamtide、eloralintide、CagriSema）は肥満およびT2DMの両方に治療的潜在力を持ち、特にCagriSemaはT2DMにおいて最も研究が進んでおり、治療経験のない患者では約半数に寛解を達成した。
items.why_matters_ja: T2DMと肥満は世界的な主要な健康課題であり、アミリンベースのagonistはこれらの疾患管理において有望な治療選択肢を提供する可能性がある。

items.title: Combined Semaglutide and Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitor Use and Metabolic Outcomes in Chinese Adults With Diabetes: Post Hoc Analysis.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Real-world use of once-weekly semaglutide in adults with type 2 diabetes in China has been shown in SCHOLAR. This post hoc analysis investigated the use of combination semaglutide-sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitor (SGLT2i) treatment, glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) changes, and safety in a subset of SCHOLAR participants.
METHODS: Participants from SCHOLAR were included in this post hoc, single-arm analysis if they were prescribed once-weekly subcutaneous semaglutide and had ≥ 1 SGLT2i prescription within 6 months of initiating semaglutide. Participants were grouped according to whether semaglutide use was continuous or not and by baseline HbA1c (≥ 7%). We evaluated the proportion of SCHOLAR participants prescribed combined semaglutide-SGLT2i. Key endpoints were: change in HbA1c from baseline to month 6; proportion of participants achieving a HbA1c level  < 7% at month 6; change in lipid profile from baseline to month 6; and safety profile of combined semaglutide-SGLT2i.
RESULTS: A total of 11,361 (42.3%) SCHOLAR participants were treated with combined semaglutide-SGLT2i. Mean change in HbA1c (95% confidence interval [CI]) from baseline to month 6 was - 0.64%-points (- 0.71, - 0.56) (p < 0.0001) for the overall combined semaglutide-SGLT2i group. The greatest change was seen in the continuous semaglutide group with baseline HbA1c ≥ 7% (- 1.20%-points [95% CI - 1.36, - 1.04]). The proportion of participants with HbA1c levels  < 7% increased from 37.8% at baseline to 55.1% at month 6 for the overall combined treatment group. There were significant reductions in mean total cholesterol (p < 0.0001), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (p < 0.0001), and triglycerides (p = 0.0043) as well as a significant increase in high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (p < 0.0001). Gastrointestinal adverse events were most frequent.
CONCLUSIONS: Combined semaglutide-SGLT2i treatment was prevalent in this subset of the SCHOLAR population and associated with significant reduction in HbA1c and changes in lipid profile. The safety profile of combined semaglutide-SGLT2i was similar to the overall SCHOLAR population.
TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT06351748.

items.title: Risk factors for recurrent urinary tract infection after SGLT2 inhibitor reinitiation in type 2 diabetes.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: To determine the risk of recurrent urinary tract infection (UTI) after early reinitiation of sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) in adults with type 2 diabetes and to identify patient-level factors associated with recurrence.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study. Adults with type 2 diabetes who discontinued an SGLT2i after an index UTI and were subsequently restarted were classified by reinitiation timing (early vs delayed). Recurrent UTI was defined as a new, clinically coded episode following reinitiation. Multivariable models assessed associations between recurrence and demographics, comorbidities, glycemic control, renal function, and psychiatric history.
RESULTS: Among 316 patients who restarted SGLT2i within 21 days during or after the first UTI episode, recurrent UTI occurred in 43.99% after 14 days post-reinitiation. In the combined cohort (n = 395), early reinitiation (<21 days) showed a trend toward increased recurrence risk compared to delayed reinitiation (≥21 days) in unadjusted Cox regression (HR 1.348; 95% CI 0.948-1.915; p = 0.096) and logistic regression (OR 1.305; 95% CI 0.797-2.139; p = 0.290), though neither reached statistical significance. After adjusting for baseline covariates, the trend persisted (adjusted Cox HR 2.011; 95% CI 0.973-4.158; p = 0.0592). In univariable Cox regression analysis of the combined cohort, female sex (HR 0.649 for males; 95% CI 0.448-0.942), higher HbA1c (HR 1.09 per %; 95% CI 1.004-1.184), and reduced eGFR (HR 0.992 per ml/min/1.73 m²; 95% CI 0.987-0.998) were identified as factors significantly associated with recurrence.
CONCLUSIONS: In this retrospective cohort of patients whose UTI was clinically coded and treated with antibiotics, recurrence was less frequent among men with preserved renal function and lower HbA1c, suggesting early SGLT2i reinitiation is a reasonable option in this subgroup. No conclusion could be drawn for higher-risk patients. The comparison of early versus delayed reinitiation remained inconclusive: the point estimate favored delayed reinitiation but did not reach significance (adjusted HR 2.011; 95% CI 0.973-4.158). In univariable analysis, female sex, older age, poor glycemic control, and impaired renal function were associated with recurrence. As ascertainment required a coded encounter and an antibiotic prescription, these findings apply only to clinically significant episodes. Randomized trials are needed to define optimal timing.
items.authors: Hsueh Yu-Chu, Lin Chia-Hung, Liu Pi-Hua, Lin Yi-Hsuan
items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病においてSGLT2阻害薬（SGLT2i）を中断後に再開した成人を対象とした後方視的コホート研究。最初の尿路感染症（UTI）後にSGLT2iを再開した患者を再開タイミング（早期＜21日 vs 遅延≥21日）で分類し、再開後の再発UTIのリスクおよび関連する患者レベルの因子を多変量モデルで評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 早期再開（＜21日）は再発リスク増加の傾向を示したが統計的有意差には達しなかった（調整後Cox HR 2.011; 95% CI 0.973-4.158; p=0.0592）。単変量解析では、女性、高齢、血糖コントロール不良（HbA1c上昇）、腎機能低下が再発と有意に関連した。
items.why_matters_ja: SGLT2iはUTIリスクを高めることが知られており、UTI後の再開タイミングは臨床的に重要な判断事項である。本研究は、男性・腎機能保存・HbA1cが低い患者では早期再開が合理的な選択肢である可能性を示唆する一方、高リスク患者では結論が得られず、最適な再開タイミングを決定するためにはランダム化比較試験が必要であることを示している。

items.endpoint_results_ja: 21日以内にSGLT2iを再開した316例中、再開後14日で再発UTIが43.99%に発生。統合コホート（n=395）において、早期再開（＜21日）vs 遅延再開（≥21日）の比較：非調整Cox回帰 HR 1.348（95% CI 0.948-1.915; p=0.096）、ロジスティック回帰 OR 1.305（95% CI 0.797-2.139; p=0.290）、いずれも統計的有意差なし。ベースライン共変量調整後Cox HR 2.011（95% CI 0.973-4.158; p=0.0592）。単変量Cox回帰：男性（HR 0.649; 95% CI 0.448-0.942）、HbA1c上昇（HR 1.09 per %; 95% CI 1.004-1.184）、eGFR低下（HR 0.992 per ml/min/1.73m²; 95% CI 0.987-0.998）が再発と有意に関連。

items.title: Effectiveness of Finerenone in Slowing Chronic Kidney Disease Progression After Hospitalization for Heart Failure: A FIDELITY Subgroup Analysis.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Finerenone, a nonsteroidal mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist, reduces risk of heart and kidney outcomes in people with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and type 2 diabetes (T2D). Heart failure is the leading cause of hospitalization in patients with CKD. Here we evaluated whether the reduction in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) decline (CKD progression) with finerenone persists after hospitalization for heart failure (HHF).
METHODS AND RESULTS: This post hoc analysis utilized the FIDELITY dataset pooled from the phase 3 FIDELIO-DKD (NCT02540993) and FIGARO-DKD (NCT02545049) trials, comprising adults with CKD and T2D on optimized renin-angiotensin system inhibitor treatment, randomized 1:1 to finerenone or placebo. Participants included experienced HHF between 4 months post randomization and study end. The key outcome was change in chronic eGFR slope (eGFR estimated from serum creatinine) before and after HHF. To avoid confounding from serum creatinine changes preceding and following HHF, eGFR values ±90 (primary analysis), ±120, and ±150 days from HHF were excluded. Baseline characteristics, medications, and mean hospital stay length were generally balanced between treatment groups. For the primary analysis, both the pre-HHF and post-HHF mean change in eGFR declined slower with finerenone versus placebo (between-group difference 2.68 mL/min/1.73 m2/year [95% confidence interval [CI], 0.87 to 4.49] pre-HHF and 0.96 mL/min/1.73 m2/year [95% CI, -0.99 to 2.91] post-HHF).
CONCLUSION: Treatment with finerenone is associated with clinically meaningful attenuation of CKD progression in people with CKD and T2D before HHF, and persists post-HHF, suggesting that maintaining finerenone after HHF may continue to confer benefits in attenuating CKD progression.
items.authors: Shafi Tariq, Anker Stefan D, Pitt Bertram, Ruilope Luis M, Rossing Peter, Brinker Meike, Rohwedder Katja, Scott Charlie
items.summary_ja: CKDと2型糖尿病（T2D）を有する患者において、非ステロイド性ミネラルコルチコイド受容体拮抗薬フィネレノンのeGFR低下速度の抑制（CKD進行の遅延）が、心不全による入院（HHF）後も持続するかを評価したFIDELITY（FIDELIO-DKDとFIGARO-DKDのプールデータ）のpost hoc解析。HHF前後のeGFRスロプの変化を主要アウトカムとし、HHF前後±90日（主要解析）、±120日、±150日のeGFR値を除外して解析を行った。
items.key_takeaway_ja: フィネレノンによるCKD進行の抑制はHHF前に臨床的に有意な効果を示し、HHF後も持続した。HHF後もフィネレノンを継続することでCKD進行の抑制効果が得られる可能性が示唆された。
items.why_matters_ja: 心不全はCKD患者の入院の最も多い原因であり、HHF前後でCKD進行の速度が変化する可能性がある。本解析は、HHFという臨床的に重要なイベント後もフィネレノンの腎保護効果が持続することを示し、HHF後の治療継続の根拠を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 第III相RCT（FIDELIO-DKDおよびFIGARO-DKD）のプールデータ（FIDELITY）を用いたpost hocサブグループ解析
items.endpoints_ja: HHF前後の慢性eGFRスロプの変化（血清クレアチニンから推定したeGFR）

items.title: Does higher kidney risk justify more finerenone? Reappraising absolute benefit against the safety window of FINEARTS-HF.
items.abstract: Chronic kidney disease has long been viewed as a reason for caution when prescribing mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs) in heart failure (HF), a doctrine rooted in the safety record of the steroidal agents: in TOPCAT, drug discontinuation for adverse events rose steeply as kidney function declined. The prespecified kidney-risk analysis of FINEARTS-HF, which reported consistent relative benefit of the non-steroidal MRA finerenone across KDIGO risk bands with a non-significant interaction on the primary endpoint, is widely read as a mandate to treat higher-risk patients more readily. We welcome this move away from reflexive under-treatment, but argue that a careful reading supports a more qualified conclusion than "worse kidneys, therefore more finerenone." Two features deserve emphasis. First, the reassuring safety signal was generated within the trial's enrolment window, which excluded patients with an eGFR below 25 mL/min/1.73 m2 or a serum potassium above 5.0 mmol/L; extending "no excess hyperkalaemia" to the very-low-eGFR patients who most concern clinicians is an extrapolation, not a demonstrated finding. Second, absolute benefit did not increase smoothly with rising kidney risk: modelled absolute reductions were not largest in the highest-risk stratum, and a non-significant interaction test does not establish that the treatment effect is identical across strata. Earlier, larger falls in albuminuria among higher-risk patients are encouraging but remain a candidate intermediate endpoint rather than proof of durable cardiorenal gains. We therefore propose a proportionate strategy: allow a higher renal-risk band to prompt consideration of finerenone in suitable patients, resist equating a uniform relative risk with uniformly maximal absolute benefit or unchanged safety at very low eGFR, and escalate potassium monitoring in parallel with renal risk, especially at or beyond the trial's boundaries. The strongest inference is that finerenone is effective and well tolerated in patients with moderately advanced CKD, normal potassium, and close follow-up; its least secure inference is that the highest-risk patients are ipso facto the safest or most deserving recipients. Future work should define optimal monitoring for patients whose eGFR drifts very low during treatment.
items.authors: Guo Song, Li Yu
items.summary_ja: FINEARTS-HFの事前指定された腎リスク解析について、非ステロイド性MRAフィネレノンのKDIGOリスク帯域を通じた相対的効果の一貫性を再検討した論評。安全性シグナルはeGFR 25 mL/min/1.73 m2未満または血清カリウム5.0 mmol/L超の患者を除外した入選基準内で得られたものであり、絶対的効果は腎リスクの上昇に伴って滑らかに増加しなかったことを指摘し、「腎機能が悪いほどフィネレノンを積極的に」という単純な解釈には留保が必要と主張する。
items.key_takeaway_ja: フィネレノンは中等度CKD・カリウム正常・近接フォローアップのもとで有効かつ良好な忍容性を示すが、最高リスク患者が最も安全かつ最も適応であるという推論は最も不確実である。
items.why_matters_ja: FINEARTS-HFの腎リスク解析が「腎リスクが高いほどフィネレノンを積極的に投与すべき」と広く解釈されている現状に対し、安全性の一般化が試験の入選基準を超えた外挿であること、絶対的効果の層別分布が均一ではないことを指摘し、臨床現場での過剰な一般化を是正する意義を持つ。
items.study_type_ja: 論評（Perspective/Commentary）
items.endpoints_ja: FINEARTS-HFの主要エンドポイント（腎リスク帯域間の交互作用が非有意）、アルブミン尿（中間エンドポイント候補）

items.title: Effectiveness of Adding GLP-1 Receptor Agonists to SGLT2 Inhibitor Therapy in Chronic Kidney Disease: A Population Based Study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Individually, sodium-glucose co-transporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) have been shown to reduce major kidney and cardiovascular events in patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD). However, evidence supporting combined GLP-1RA and SGLT2i therapy in this population remains limited.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX Global Collaborative Network, including adults with CKD treated with SGLT2i alone or SGLT2i with subsequent initiation of GLP-1RA between June 2020 and December 2023. Propensity score matching (1:1) adjusted for demographics, comorbidities, medications, and laboratory values. The primary outcome was major adverse kidney events (MAKE); secondary outcomes included all-cause mortality and major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE). Time-to-event analyses were performed using Cox proportional hazards models.
RESULTS: Among 112 596 patients with CKD, 16460 received SGLT2i and GLP-1RA combination therapy, and 96 136 received SGLT2i monotherapy. The matched cohort included 32 448 patients (16 224 per group). Over a median follow-up of 12 months, the addition of a GLP-1RA was associated with lower rates of the primary outcome of MAKE (HR 0.70; 95% CI 0.65-0.74; p < 0.001) compared with SGLT2i monotherapy. Combination therapy was also associated with lower risks of MACE (HR 0.83; 95% CI 0.78-0.87) and all-cause mortality (HR 0.55; 95% CI 0.50-0.61). Benefits were consistent across CKD stages and diabetes status, with significantly more pronounced effects observed in patients with obesity, heart failure, and ischemic heart disease. Combination therapy was associated with increased gastrointestinal symptoms, genital infections, and retinopathy progression, but lower risks of volume-depletion events and acute kidney injury.
CONCLUSIONS: In this real-world CKD cohort, GLP-1RA added to SGLT2i therapy was associated with substantial incremental reductions in kidney disease progression and cardiovascular events. These findings suggest an additive cardiorenal benefit, particularly in patients with obesity, supporting the evaluation of combination therapy in future randomised trials.
items.authors: Salim Hussain, Qureshi Shaheer, Gulsin Gaurav S, Khan Habib R, Waqas Saad Ahmed, McCann Gerry P, Garg Amit, Shurrab Mohammed
items.summary_ja: TriNetX Global Collaborative Networkを用いた後方視コホート研究。2020年6月から2023年12月の間にCKDを有しSGLT2i単独療法またはSGLT2iにGLP-1RAを追加した成人を対象とし、プロパensityスコアマッチング（1:1）により32,448例（各群16,224例）を比較した。中央値12カ月の追跡期間において、GLP-1RAの追加はMAKE（主要エンドポイント）、MACE、全死因死亡率のいずれも有意に低かった。CKDステージや糖尿病の有無を問わず一貫した効果が見られ、肥満、心不全、虚血性心疾患を有する患者でより顕著な効果を示した。有害事象として消化管症状、生殖器感染症、網膜症の進行が増加したが、容量減少イベントと急性腎障害のリスクは低下した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CKD患者においてSGLT2i療法にGLP-1RAを追加することで、腎疾患の進行と心血管イベントの有意な追加的減少が認められ、特に肥満を有する患者で加算的な心腎保護効果が示唆された。
items.why_matters_ja: CKD患者におけるGLP-1RAとSGLT2iの併用療法の有効性に関するエビデンスは限定的であったが、本大規模リアルワールドコホート研究は併用による加算的な心腎保護効果を示し、将来のランダム化試験での併用療法の評価を支持する根拠を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視コホート研究（TriNetX Global Collaborative Networkを用いたpopulation-based研究、プロパensityスコアマッチング1:1）
items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：MAKE（major adverse kidney events）。二次エンドポイント：全死因死亡率、MACE（major adverse cardiovascular events）。

items.title: Hypothalamic obesity in pediatric vs. adult craniopharyngioma: mechanisms, management, and cardiometabolic outcomes.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: Hypothalamic obesity (HO) is a treatment-related complication in craniopharyngioma (CP) survivors that markedly impairs long-term health and quality of life. Although overall survival exceeds 90% for both pediatric and adult CP, HO prevalence and clinical course differ substantially by age at onset. We aimed to compare HO manifestations, mechanisms, and treatment response between pediatric and adult CP cohorts.
METHODS: We conducted a scoping review of studies published between 2000 and 2025, comparing pediatric (childhood-onset) versus adult-onset CP cohorts, classified by age at diagnosis. Data on obesity prevalence, mechanistic pathways, therapeutic interventions, and cardiometabolic outcomes were extracted and synthesized.
RESULTS: In pediatric CP survivors, obesity rates rise from 5.7% pre-treatment to 57% post-treatment; in adults, from 19.2% to 29.2%. HO severity correlates with the extent of hypothalamic damage by Puget and QST grading. Key mechanisms include disrupted melanocortin signaling, central leptin and insulin resistance, and neuroinflammation via resistin-TLR4 and NLRP3 pathways. GLP-1 receptor agonists (exenatide, semaglutide) have produced marked weight loss in small case series (up to 17% over 6 months with semaglutide), but randomized trials did not meet their primary weight outcomes and direct pediatric-versus-adult comparisons are lacking. Bariatric procedures yield moderate success; sleeve gastrectomy achieves 5-year weight loss comparable to that in non-CP controls (21.7% vs. 21.8%), whereas Roux-en-Y gastric bypass is less effective than in controls (22.7% vs. 32.0%). Both cohorts face significant long-term risks: 2.2-fold higher all-cause mortality and 9.3-fold higher diabetes risk in adults, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in 47% of pediatric survivors, metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease in 67.4% of adults, and insulin resistance in approximately 30% of pediatric patients.
CONCLUSION: HO following CP shows distinct age-dependent trajectories in prevalence, underlying mechanisms, and clinical course; suggested age-related differences in treatment response remain to be confirmed in direct comparative studies. Tailored management integrating mechanistic insights and age-specific therapies is critical to mitigating the cardiometabolic burden in these patients.
items.authors: Gupta Khushal, Zeinali Maryam, Altschul David, Agarwal Vijay, Karsy Michael
items.summary_ja: 2000年から2025年までに発表された研究を対象としたスコーピングレビューであり、小児期発症群と成人発症群の頭蓋咽頭腫（CP）生存者における視床下部性肥満（HO）の発現、機序、治療反応性を比較した。肥満有病率、機能的経路、治療介入、心代謝転帰のデータを抽出・統合した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CP後のHOは有病率、基礎機序、臨床経過において年齢依存性の異なる軌跡を示す。治療反応性の年齢関連差は示唆されるものの、直接的比較研究による確認が未だ必要である。
items.why_matters_ja: HOはCP生存者の長期健康と生活の質を著しく損なう。両群とも全死因死亡率の増加（成人で2.2倍）、糖尿病リスクの増加（成人で9.3倍）、脂肪肝疾患（小児47%、成人67.4%）などの重大な長期心代謝リスクに直面しており、機序に基づく年齢特異的治療戦略の確立が不可欠である。
items.study_type_ja: スコーピングレビュー
items.endpoints_ja: 治療前後の肥満有病率、GLP-1受容体作動薬による体重減少率、肥満手術後の5年体重減少率、全死因死亡率、糖尿病リスク、非アルコール性脂肪肝疾患（NAFLD）/代謝機能異常関連脂肪肝疾患（MASLD）有病率、インスリン抵抗性有病率
items.endpoint_results_ja: 小児CP：治療前肥満率5.7%→治療後57%。成人CP：治療前19.2%→治療後29.2%。セマグルチド：小規模症例系列で6ヶ月間で最大17%の体重減少（ランダム化試験では主要体重アウトカムに達しなかった）。スリーブ胃切除術：5年体重減少率21.7%（CP群）vs 21.8%（非CP対照群）。Roux-en-Y胃バイパス術：22.7%（CP群）vs 32.0%（非CP対照群）。全死因死亡率：成人で2.2倍。糖尿病リスク：成人で9.3倍。NAFLD：小児生存者の47%。MASLD：成人の67.4%。インスリン抵抗性：小児患者の約30%。

items.title: Outcomes of GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Therapy after Liver Transplantation in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes: A Real-World Cohort Study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are increasingly used to manage type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) in liver transplant (LT) recipients, but their impact on graft outcomes remains unclear. This study evaluated clinical and graft-related outcomes associated with GLP-1 RA therapy.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX Network, identifying adults with LT and T2DM. Two cohorts were defined: LT recipients treated with GLP-1 RAs and those receiving conventional antidiabetic therapy. Propensity score matching (1:1) was applied based on demographics, comorbidities, and immunosuppressive regimens. The index date was the first GLP-1 RA prescription within six months before or after LT. Outcomes assessed at one year included all-cause mortality, graft rejection, graft failure, biliary stricture, hepatic artery thrombosis, and transplant-related infections. Analyses used Kaplan-Meier survival curves and Cox proportional hazards models.
RESULTS: After matching, 704 patients were included in each cohort. GLP-1 RA use was associated with significantly lower mortality (4.2% vs. 12.6%; HR=0.33, 95%CI: 0.22-0.50; p<0.0001) and reduced risks of rejection (9.0% vs. 15.5%; HR=0.55; p=0.0008), graft failure (7.1% vs. 13.8%; HR=0.50; p=0.0002), biliary stricture (4.1% vs. 6.7%; HR=0.60; p=0.0342), infections (5.7% vs. 10.1%; HR=0.54; p=0.0032), and hepatic artery thrombosis (5.4% vs. 10.7%; HR=0.48; p=0.0007).
CONCLUSIONS: GLP-1 RA therapy was associated with improved survival and lower rates of major post-transplant complications, suggesting a potential role as preferred antidiabetic therapy in LT recipients with T2DM.

items.summary_ja: 肝移植（LT）受容者かつ2型糖尿病（T2DM）を有する成人を対象に、TriNetXネットワークを用いた後方視コホート研究を実施した。GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）群と従来型抗糖尿病薬群を1:1の傾向スコアマッチングで比較し、移植後1年時点の全死因死亡率、移植片拒絶反応、移植片不全、胆管狭窄、肝動脈閉塞、移植関連感染症を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1 RA療法は、肝移植受容者において全死因死亡率の低下（4.2% vs. 12.6%）および移植片拒絶反応、移植片不全、胆管狭窄、肝動脈閉塞、移植関連感染症のリスク低下と関連し、T2DMを有するLT受容者における優先抗糖尿病療法としての可能性を示唆した。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1 RAは肝移植受容者のT2DM管理にますます使用されているが、移植片アウトカムへの影響は不明であった。本研究は、GLP-1 RAが移植後重大合併症の低減に寄与する可能性を示し、臨床実践における抗糖尿病薬選択の根拠を提供する。

items.title: Empagliflozin Promotes Natriuresis in Diabetic Patients with Cirrhotic Refractory Ascites: A Proof-of-Concept Study.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Interventional studies directly targeting natriuresis in refractory cirrhotic ascites are scarce, and no prospective study has examined whether sodium-glucose transporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitor-induced glucosuria is associated with changes in renal sodium handling. We conducted a randomized, open-label, proof-of-concept study to characterize the short-term natriuretic response to empagliflozin in patients with diabetes and refractory ascites Methods: Adults with type 2 diabetes, decompensated cirrhosis, and refractory ascites were randomized 1:1 to empagliflozin 10 mg once daily plus standard care or standard care alone for 10 days. The primary outcome was the between-group difference in mean change in fractional excretion of sodium (FENa, %) from baseline (Day 0) to the mean of post-baseline Days 1, 3, 7, and 10, estimated using a linear mixed-effects model. Key secondary outcomes included 24-hour urinary sodium excretion, 24-hour urine volume, and mean daily paracentesis volume.
RESULTS: Twenty-one participants were randomized (empagliflozin n=10; control n=11). In the empagliflozin group, the between-group difference in mean change in FENa from baseline to the post-baseline mean (days 1, 3, 7, and 10) was +0.44 percentage points (95%CI: 0.05-0.83; p=0.029). Empagliflozin increased 24-hour urinary sodium excretion by +92.1 mmol/24 h (95%CI: 47.1-137.2) and 24-hour urine volume by + 822 mL/24 h (95%CI: 403-1240) versus control. Mean daily paracentesis volume was 0.6 ± 0.4 L/day with empagliflozin and 1.3 ± 0.6 L/day with control (mean difference -0.70 L/day, 95%CI: -1.17 to -0.23). No serious adverse events occurred.
CONCLUSIONS: In this open-label, proof-of-concept study, empagliflozin was associated with improved short-term natriuretic indices over 10 days in diabetic patients with decompensated cirrhosis and refractory ascites, without serious adverse events. Larger, blinded, longer-term trials are warranted to confirm these preliminary findings.

items.summary_ja: 2型糖尿病を合併した失代償期肝硬変・難治性腹水患者において、エンパグリフロジン10 mg 1日1回を10日間投与した際の短期間のナトリウム排泄能への影響を評価したランダム化、オープンラベル、概念実証試験。エンパグリフロジン群と標準治療単独群を1:1で割り付け、主要エンドポイントはベースラインからベースライン後（Day 1, 3, 7, 10）の平均までのナトリウム排泄分画（FENa, %）の平均変化の群間差とした。
items.key_takeaway_ja: エンパグリフロジンは、糖尿病を合併した失代償期肝硬変・難治性腹水患者において、10日間でFENa（+0.44ポイント）、24時間尿ナトリウム排泄量（+92.1 mmol/24 h）、24時間尿量（+822 mL/24 h）を対照群と比較して有意に増加させ、平均1日腹水穿刺量を減少させた（-0.70 L/day）。重大な有害事象は認められなかった。
items.why_matters_ja: 難治性肝性腹水に対するナトリウム排泄を直接標的とする介入研究は少なく、SGLT2阻害薬誘発のグルコース尿が腎ナトリウム処理の変化と関連するかどうかを前向きに評価した研究は本例が初例である。SGLT2阻害薬が肝性腹水管理に新たな治療選択肢となり得る可能性を示唆する。

items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：ベースライン（Day 0）からベースライン後（Day 1, 3, 7, 10）の平均までのナトリウム排泄分画（FENa, %）の平均変化の群間差（線形混合効果モデルで推定）。主要二次エンドポイント：24時間尿ナトリウム排泄量、24時間尿量、平均1日腹水穿刺量。

items.title: Incretin-based injectable strategies versus intensified insulin for treatment intensification and simplification in type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: Prandial insulin intensification in Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) improves glycaemia but increases regimen complexity, weight gain, and hypoglycaemia risk. Our aim was to evaluate if Incretin-based injectable strategies offer a lower-burden alternative across intensification and simplification pathways.
METHODS: PubMed/MEDLINE, CENTRAL, Scopus, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched to November 2025 for Randomised Controlled Trials (RCT) comparing incretin-based injectable regimens with intensified insulin strategies in adults with T2D. Primary outcomes were HbA1c change and trial-defined hypoglycaemia. Secondary outcomes included body weight, HbA1c target achievement, severe hypoglycaemia, insulin dose, gastrointestinal adverse events, and adverse-event withdrawals. Random or fixed-effects models were applied where appropriate, with subgroup analyses by regimen and by intensification versus simplification design.
RESULTS: Eighteen RCTs were included. Incretin-based regimens significantly reduced HbA1c as compared to intensified insulin (MD -0.19%, 95% CI: -0.34 to -0.05, P = 0.01) and also increased HbA1c target achievement (RR 1.27, 95% CI: 1.05 to 1.54, P = 0.01). Effects differed by regimen and design: tirzepatide produced the largest HbA1c reduction, fixed-ratio or once-weekly combination regimens showed similar HbA1c efficacy, and simplification trials generally preserved glycaemic control. Incretin-based regimens decreased trial-defined hypoglycaemia (RR 0.48, 95% CI: 0.35 to 0.66, P = 0.00001), severe hypoglycaemia (RR 0.32, 95% CI: 0.19 to 0.51, P = 0.00001), and body weight (MD -4.65 kg, 95% CI: -5.85 to -3.44, P = 0.00001). Gastrointestinal adverse events were more frequent with incretin-based regimens.
CONCLUSION: Incretin-based injectable strategies are a favourable alternative to intensified insulin when hypoglycaemia, weight gain, and treatment burden are priorities, but benefits differ between intensification and simplification settings.
SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s40200-026-02089-x.

items.summary_ja: インクレチン系注射製剤戦略とインスリン強化療法を比較した18件のRCTを含む系統的レビューおよびメタ解析。インクレチン系注射製剤はHbA1c低下、HbA1c目標達成率向上、低血糖（試験定義および重症）の減少、体重減少においてインスリン強化療法より優位であった。一方、消化管有害事象はインクレチン系でより頻発した。

items.why_matters_ja: T2Dにおけるインスリン強化療法は血糖改善をもたらすが、レジメンの複雑化、体重増加、低血糖リスクの増加を伴う。インクレチン系注射製剤がこれらの負担を軽減しつつ血糖管理を維持できるかを示すことで、治療強化・簡素化の意思決定に直接的な根拠を提供する。

items.title: Feasibility of the Comprehensive Overweight/Obesity Management Pre-Kidney Transplant Program: A Group-Based Lifestyle Intervention and GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Therapy for End-Stage Kidney Disease Candidates Ineligible Due to Obesity.
items.abstract:
PURPOSE: The purpose of this study was to evaluate the feasibility of applying a structured interprofessional weight-loss intervention to improve transplant eligibility among candidates with body mass index (BMI) >35 kg/m².
METHODS: The Comprehensive Overweight/Obesity Management Pre-Kidney Transplant (COMPKT) program was a single-arm feasibility study at an academic center. Participants attended 15 weekly virtual group education sessions using the National Diabetes Prevention Program PreventT2 curriculum delivered by trained lifestyle coaches, with remote monitoring and interprofessional pharmacotherapy management including glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist or GLP-1/glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide co-agonist therapy when clinically appropriate. Feasibility outcomes were enrollment, attendance, and GLP-1 uptake; clinical outcomes were BMI and percentage weight change.
RESULTS: Twenty-nine participants from the first 3 cohorts (median baseline BMI 41.1 kg/m²; interquartile range 40.4-44.8) were analyzed. Attendance varied: 44.8% attended < 50% of sessions, 20.7% attended 50% to 75%, and 34.5% attended > 75%. GLP-1 therapy use rose from 62.1% at baseline to 72.4% at session 15, with 52.4% reaching high-dose therapy. Median weight change was -3.44% (range -10.89% to +1.91%). Participants attending ≥ 50% of sessions had greater median weight loss than those with lower attendance, independent of GLP-1 use. Two participants received kidney transplants during the evaluation period.
CONCLUSIONS: COMPKT was feasible and produced modest but clinically meaningful weight loss in a high-risk population. Session engagement, rather than GLP-1 pharmacotherapy alone, appeared to drive outcomes, informing future program design and implementation.

items.summary_ja: BMI>35 kg/m²により腎移植適格とならない末期腎不全（ESRD）候補者に対し、構造化された多職種による減量介入（COMPKTプログラム）の実用性を評価した単群実用性試験。15週間のオンライングループ教育（PreventT2カリキュラム）とGLP-1受容体作動薬（またはGLP-1/GIP共作動薬）の併用を施行した。最初の3コホートから29名を解析した。ベースライン中央値BMIは41.1 kg/m²（IQR 40.4-44.8）であり、中央値体重変化は-3.44%（範囲 -10.89%～+1.91%）であった。セッション出席率50%以上の参加者はGLP-1使用の有無にかかわらず、出席率の低い参加者より中央値減量量が大きかった。評価期間中に2名が腎移植を受けた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1薬物療法単独よりも、セッションへの参加（出席率≥50%）が体重減少の成果を駆動する要因であった。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満（BMI>35）は腎移植適格性の障壁であり、ESRD候補者の移植可能性を向上させるための実用的な介入プログラムとして、グループベースの生活習慣介入とGLP-1受容体作動薬の併用が実用性を持ち、臨床的に意味のある減量をもたらすことを示した。

items.title: Suitability of the ICH S1B(R1) weight-of-evidence framework to evaluate glucagon-like protein-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA) carcinogenicity risk.
items.abstract: Glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) are an established treatment for management of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) and obesity. While these agents provide clinical benefits, chronic rodent bioassays have shown a consistent increase in thyroid C-cell tumors, raising regulatory concerns for human carcinogenicity risk and resulting in a boxed warning for medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC). However, the human relevance of the rodent tumors is unclear due to species differences in GLP-1 receptor (GLP-1R) biology. Carcinogenicity testing of pharmaceuticals is described in ICH S1 guidelines. ICH S1B(R1) outlines experimental approaches to carcinogenicity evaluation including a weight-of-evidence (WoE) framework to determine whether long-term rat carcinogenicity studies add value to human cancer risk assessments. This manuscript applies that framework across seven approved GLP-1RAs: lixisenatide, exenatide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, semaglutide, tirzepatide, and albiglutide, to evaluate the relevance of rodent thyroid tumors and the utility of 2-year bioassays for this drug class. Across all six WoE domains, the evidence supports concluding that GLP1-RAs are tumorigenic in rats via a known human-irrelevant mechanism. Thus, within the S1B(R1) WoE framework, future carcinogenicity testing in rats is unlikely to provide additional value for regulatory decision-making for this class of pharmaceuticals.
items.authors: Roach Katherine A, Khazaee Manoochehr, Mohar Isaac, Boon Denali, Cronin Brigitte, Gauthier Alex G
items.summary_ja: 本論文は、ICH S1B(R1)のweight-of-evidence（WoE）フレームワークを7つの承認済みGLP-1受容体作動薬（リクセナチド、エクセナチド、リラグルチド、デュラグルチド、セマグルチド、tirzepatide、アルビグルチド）に適用し、ラット甲状腺C細胞腫瘍のヒト関連性及び2年間の発がん性試験の有用性を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 6つのWoEドメインすべてにおいて、GLP-1受容体作動薬はヒトに関連しない既知の機構によりラットで腫瘍原性であるという結論が支持され、この薬剤クラスに対する今後のラット発がん性試験は規制上の意思決定に追加的な価値を提供 unlikely と判断された。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬はラット長期発がん性試験における甲状腺C細胞腫瘍の増加に基づき、髄様甲状腺癌（MTC）のboxed warningを有しているが、種差によるGLP-1受容体生物学の違いからヒトへの関連性は不明確である。本分析は、この薬剤クラスにおける長期ラット発がん性試験の必要性をWoEフレームワークに基づき評価し、規制効率性及び開発期間に示唆を与える。

items.endpoints_ja: ICH S1B(R1) WoEフレームワークの6ドメインに基づくラット甲状腺C細胞腫瘍のヒト関連性評価、及び2年間発がん性試験の規制上の有用性

items.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists in Heart Failure: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis with Phenotype-Specific Effects and Dual Analytical Frameworks.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Although glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) reduce cardiovascular risk in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2D), evidence in heart failure (HF) has expanded across diverse trial populations and HF phenotypes but remains fragmented. We therefore performed an integrated systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate the effects of GLP-1 RAs across the spectrum of HF using complementary trial-level and phenotype-based analyses.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science were systematically searched for studies published from inception to August 10, 2025. To provide an integrated assessment across heterogeneous HF populations, treatment effects were evaluated using dual analytical frameworks: trial-level analyses according to study design (dedicated HF with preserved ejection fraction [HFpEF] trials, HF with reduced ejection fraction [HFrEF] trials, and HF subgroups from cardiovascular outcome trials [CVOTs]) and phenotype-based analyses according to left ventricular ejection fraction (HFpEF vs HFrEF using a pragmatic threshold of 40%). A prespecified targeted analysis was conducted to specifically assess the efficacy of semaglutide. The primary outcomes were major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), and the secondary outcomes included hospitalization for HF (HHF), the composite of cardiovascular death or any worsening HF events, cardiovascular death alone, and all-cause mortality. Pooled hazard ratios (HRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated using random‑effects models.
RESULTS: This meta-analysis included 14 trials, with a pooled total of 15,882 patients with HF. In phenotype‑based analyses for HFpEF, GLP‑1 RAs significantly reduced MACE (HR 0.79; 95% CI 0.66-0.94; p = 0.010), HHF (HR 0.48; 95% CI 0.27-0.85; p = 0.012), the composite of cardiovascular death or worsening HF (HR 0.57; 95% CI 0.37-0.89; p = 0.013), and all‑cause mortality (HR 0.75; 95% CI 0.62-0.89; p = 0.001). In contrast, in HFrEF, no significant reductions were observed for HHF, the composite of cardiovascular death or worsening HF, all-cause mortality, or MACE, although a reduction in cardiovascular death was noted (HR 0.71; 95% CI 0.54-0.95; p = 0.019). Trial-level analyses showed that cardiovascular benefits were primarily observed in HF subgroups from CVOTs, including reductions in MACE (HR 0.82; 95% CI 0.73-0.92; p = 0.001), cardiovascular death (HR 0.88; 95% CI 0.77-1.00; p = 0.05) and myocardial infarction (MI)/non-fatal MI (HR 0.84; 95% CI 0.70-1.00; p = 0.046). Semaglutide showed benefits in HHF and the composite of cardiovascular death or worsening HF events predominantly among overweight or obese patients with HFpEF. GLP-1 RAs also improved functional capacity and quality of life in HFpEF.
CONCLUSION: GLP-1 RAs were associated with favorable cardiovascular and HF-related outcomes in HFpEF, predominantly among overweight or obese individuals, whereas evidence of benefit in HFrEF remains limited. In trial-level analyses, benefits were primarily observed for atherosclerotic endpoints in HF subgroups from CVOTs. By integrating evidence, this study provides a unified overview of the effects of GLP-1 RAs across the spectrum of HF and supports further phenotype-specific randomized trials, particularly dedicated studies in HFrEF.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: Protocol registration PROSPERO (CRD420251079970).
items.authors: Yuan Yahui, Chen Chun, Li Xiuming, Guo Jingyi, Liu Qiaoyun, Lin YuPing, Sun Lu, Fan Guanjie
items.summary_ja: GLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1 RA）が心不全（HF）スペクトラム全体に及ぼす効果を評価するため、試験レベル解析（HFpEF専用試験、HFrEF専用試験、CVOTのHFサブグループ）と表現型ベース解析（LVEF 40%を閾値としたHFpEF vs HFrEF）という二重分析フレームワークを用いた統合的システマティックレビューおよびメタ解析を行った。14試験、計15,882例のHF患者を対象とし、主要エンドポイントはMACE、副次エンドポイントはHF入院（HHF）、心血管死またはHF悪化の複合、心血管死単独、全死因死亡率とした。
items.key_takeaway_ja: GLP-1 RAはHFpEF（特に過体重・肥満患者）においてMACE、HHF、心血管死またはHF悪化の複合、全死因死亡率を有意に減少させたが、HFrEFにおける効果は限定的であり、心血管死の減少のみが認められた。
items.why_matters_ja: GLP-1 RAのHFスペクトラム全体における効果を統合的に整理し、表現型別の効果差を明確にしたことで、特にHFrEFにおける専用ランダム化試験の必要性を支持する根拠を提供する。

items.endpoints_ja: 主要エンドポイント：MACE。副次エンドポイント：HF入院（HHF）、心血管死またはHF悪化の複合、心血管死単独、全死因死亡率。
items.endpoint_results_ja: 【HFpEF（表現型ベース解析）】MACE：HR 0.79（95% CI 0.66-0.94; p=0.010）、HHF：HR 0.48（95% CI 0.27-0.85; p=0.012）、心血管死またはHF悪化の複合：HR 0.57（95% CI 0.37-0.89; p=0.013）、全死因死亡率：HR 0.75（95% CI 0.62-0.89; p=0.001）。【HFrEF（表現型ベース解析）】HHF：有意な減少なし、心血管死またはHF悪化の複合：有意な減少なし、全死因死亡率：有意な減少なし、MACE：有意な減少なし、心血管死：HR 0.71（95% CI 0.54-0.95; p=0.019）。【CVOTのHFサブグループ（試験レベル解析）】MACE：HR 0.82（95% CI 0.73-0.92; p=0.001）、心血管死：HR 0.88（95% CI 0.77-1.00; p=0.05）、MI/非致死性MI：HR 0.84（95% CI 0.70-1.00; p=0.046）。【セマグルチド】過体重・肥満のHFpEF患者においてHHFおよび心血管死またはHF悪化の複合に有益（具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし）。

items.title: Renal AA amyloidosis associated with severe obesity: improvement in kidney function and proteinuria following semaglutide-associated weight loss.
items.abstract: AA amyloidosis is driven by persistently elevated serum amyloid A (SAA) in chronic inflammation. Severe obesity has emerged as a potential inflammatory driver of renal AA amyloidosis. We report a 47-year-old man with prior sleeve gastrectomy who developed progressive kidney dysfunction and proteinuria after substantial weight regain. At presentation, he weighed 126 kg (body mass index, 45.2 kg/m2); serum creatinine was 4.3 mg/dL (estimated glomerular filtration rate, 15 mL/min/1.73 m2) and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) was 3.4 g/g. Kidney biopsy confirmed AA amyloidosis, while extensive evaluation for autoimmune, infectious, hereditary, malignant, and monoclonal causes was unrevealing. SAA was 80 mg/L with persistently elevated inflammatory markers. Semaglutide was initiated as part of a weight-management strategy. Following a 47-kg weight loss, creatinine decreased to 2.34 mg/dL, estimated glomerular filtration rate increased to 32 mL/min/1.73 m2, UACR declined to 1.0 g/g, and SAA fell to <10 mg/L, with improvement in C-reactive protein, erythrocyte sedimentation rate, and HbA1c. In the absence of another identifiable cause, the parallel improvement in SAA, systemic inflammation, proteinuria, and kidney function supports severe obesity as a potential inflammatory contributor to renal AA amyloidosis, although causality cannot be inferred from a single case.
items.authors: Atay Ilker, Eroz Erhan, Bayramoğlu Zeynep, Çömlekçi Abdurrahman, Korucu Berfu
items.summary_ja: 重度肥満（BMI 45.2 kg/m²）を伴う47歳男性において、腎生検でAAアミロイドーシスと診断された。セマグルチドによる減量（47 kg減）後、血清クレアチニン、eGFR、UACR、SAA、CRP、ESR、HbA1cが並行的に改善した。単一症例であり因果関係は推定できないが、重度肥満が腎AAアミロイドーシスの炎症性因子となり得ることを示唆する。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 重度肥満に伴う炎症が腎AAアミロイドーシスの潜在的要因となり得る。セマグルチドによる減量後、SAA・全身炎症・蛋白尿・腎機能が並行的に改善したが、単一症例であり因果関係は結論できない。
items.why_matters_ja: 重度肥満が腎AAアミロイドーシスの炎症性駆動因子となり得る可能性を示し、減量介入が腎機能改善に寄与し得ることを示唆する。AAアミロイドーシスの病因解明と治療戦略の拡大に寄与し得る。

items.title: Real-world effectiveness of 6-month tirzepatide therapy on body weight and composition in adults with overweight and obesity.
items.abstract:
AIMS/HYPOTHESIS: Obesity drives cardiometabolic dysfunction and increases cardiovascular risk, with excess fat mass and impaired body composition playing a key role in metabolic outcomes. This clinical study aimed to evaluate the real-world effectiveness (RWE) of tirzepatide on body weight, body composition, and metabolic parameters in adults with obesity or overweight and at least one obesity-associated comorbidity.
METHODS: A 24-week retrospective observational analysis included 122 adults (80% women; mean age 44 ± 15 years) with overweight or obesity, and without diabetes. Participants received tirzepatide in combination with a standardized low-carbohydrate diet and tailored physical activity. Tirzepatide was initiated at a dose of 2.5 mg once weekly and increased to 5 mg after 4 weeks. Subsequent dose adjustments were individualized. Anthropometric measurements, bioelectrical impedance analysis and metabolic parameters were assessed at baseline and after 24 weeks.
RESULTS: The mean dose of tirzepatide at the end of the study was 5.32 mg. In comparison to baseline, we found after 24 weeks an improvement in body weight (from 95 ± 20 to 80 ± 22 kg), BMI (from 35 ± 6 to 29 ± 7 kg/m2) waist circumference (from 109 ± 16 to 92 ± 12 cm) and waist-to-height ratio (from 0.66 ± 0.1 to 0.56 ± 0.1), all p < 0.001. Fat mass (FM) largely reduced by 35%, fat-free mass slightly decreased by 5% (p < 0.001 for both), while skeletal muscle mass was preserved (p = ns). Metabolic parameters were also improved, including HbA1c (from 5.5 ± 0.4% to 5.2 ± 0.1%, p = 0.007), fasting plasma glucose (from 93 ± 12 to 84 ± 9 mg/dL, p < 0.001), fasting insulin (from 17 ± 15 to 12 ± 9 μIU/mL, p = 0.002) and HOMA-IR (from 4.2 ± 4.7 to 2.5 ± 2.1, p = 0.001). Correlation analysis revealed that the reduction in FM was significantly associated with the reduction in both insulin (r = 0.498, p < 0.05) and HOMA-IR (r = 0.513, p < 0.05). Interestingly, the weight loss found in our real-world cohort after 24 weeks of tirzepatide therapy (-16%) was identical to that found in the SURMOUNT-1 trial but after 72 weeks.
CONCLUSIONS: In this RWE study, 24 weeks of tirzepatide treatment led to significant improvement on body weight, BMI and fat mass, together with preservation of lean skeletal muscle mass, as well as improved glycemic control and insulin sensitivity. Our findings suggest that a comprehensive clinical approach to obesity in real-world settings may be more beneficial than what observed in clinical trials.
items.journal: Journal of diabetes and its complications
items.authors: Brancato Davide, Maggio Viviana, Vaccaro Francesca, Muratore Elena, Pirrello David, Cittadini Ettore, Patti Angelo Maria, Di Falco Felicia
items.summary_ja: 肥満または過体重かつ少なくとも1つの肥満関連合併症を有する成人において、tirzepatideのリアルワールド効果（RWE）を評価した24週間の後方視的観察研究。122名の成人（女性80%、平均年齢44±15歳、糖尿病なし）が、標準化された低炭水化物食事と個別化された身体活動と組み合わせてtirzepatideを投与された。起始用量は2.5 mg/週で、4週間後に5 mgに増量し、その後の用量調整は個別化された。24週後、体重、BMI、腹囲、体脂肪量、血糖コントロール、インスリン感受性が有意に改善し、骨格筋量は維持された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 24週間のtirzepatide治療により、体重（-16%）、BMI、体脂肪量が有意に減少し、骨格筋量は維持された。また、血糖コントロールとインスリン感受性も改善した。本リアルワールドコホートでの24週間の体重減少（-16%）は、SURMOUNT-1試験の72週間後の体重減少と同等であった。
items.why_matters_ja: 肥満は心代謝機能不全を引き起こし心血管リスクを増大させるが、本リアルワールド研究では、tirzepatideを標準化された低炭水化物食事と個別化された身体活動と組み合わせた包括的な臨床アプローチにより、臨床試験で観察されたものよりも有益な結果が得られる可能性が示唆された。24週でSURMOUNT-1試験の72週相当の体重減少を達成した点は、リアルワールド設定における治療効果の臨床的意義を示している。
items.study_type_ja: 後方視的観察研究（リアルワールド効果研究）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重、BMI、腹囲、身長対腹囲比、体脂肪量（FM）、除脂肪量、骨格筋量、HbA1c、空腹時血糖、空腹時インスリン、HOMA-IR
items.sample_size_ja: 122名（女性80%、平均年齢44±15歳、糖尿病なし）

items.title: Recurrent Euglycemic Diabetic Ketoacidosis Weeks After SGLT2 Inhibitor Cessation: A Case Report.
items.abstract: Euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (EDKA) is a complication of sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors that is being increasingly documented. It is challenging to diagnose, especially in critically ill patients because hyperglycemia is absent or mild. We report the case of a 71-year-old man with type 2 diabetes mellitus previously treated with dapagliflozin, which had been discontinued 2 weeks before presentation, who was admitted for tracheostomy and percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG) placement in the context of a neurodegenerative disorder. On postoperative day 2, he was transferred to the intensive care unit (ICU) for aspiration pneumonia complicated by septic shock. He subsequently experienced recurrent episodes of high anion gap metabolic acidosis associated with positive ketonuria and relative euglycemia. The initial episode was interpreted as mixed septic lactic acidosis and SGLT2 inhibitor-associated EDKA, whereas later episodes were more consistent with isolated recurrent EDKA. Management consisted of treatment of the underlying septic shock, and repeated courses of fixed intravenous (IV) insulin infusions to close the anion gap while maintaining euglycemia. This case demonstrates the importance of suspecting EDKA, especially in critically ill patients on SGLT2 inhibitors who present with unexplained high anion gap metabolic acidosis, even when lactic acidosis is present. Early diagnosis and treatment are essential to prevent complications and relapse.
items.authors: Mansour Celine, Katrib Emile, Mansour Myriam, Fares Mirna
items.summary_ja: SGLT2阻害薬（ダパグリフロジン）を2週間前に中止された71歳の2型糖尿病患者が、神経変性疾患に対する気管切開および経皮的内視鏡的胃瘻（PEG）造設術後に、誤嚥性肺炎合併敗血症性ショックでICUに転帰した。術後2日目に高アニオンギャップ代謝性アシドーシス、ケトン尿陽性、相対的血糖正常を伴う再発性エピソードを経験した。初期エピソードは敗血症性乳酸アシドーシスとSGLT2阻害薬関連EDKAの混合型と解釈され、その後のエピソードは単独の再発性EDKAとより一致した。管理は敗血症性ショックの治療と、血糖正常を維持しながらアニオンギャップを閉じるための反復的固定量IVインスリン持続静注であった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SGLT2阻害薬使用中の重症患者で、乳酸アシドーシスが併存していても、説明不能な高アニオンギャップ代謝性アシドーシスを呈する場合はEDKAを疑うことが重要であり、SGLT2阻害薬中止後も数週間後に再発し得る。
items.why_matters_ja: EDKAは高血糖が欠如または軽度であるため診断が困難であり、特に重症患者では見逃されやすい。本症例はSGLT2阻害薬中止後数週間でEDKAが再発し得ることを示し、早期診断・治療が合併症や再発の予防に不可欠であることを強調している。

items.title: Practical Implementation of Steroidal and Nonsteroidal Mineralocorticoid Receptor Antagonists in the Management of Heart Failure.
items.abstract: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs) are a well-established treatment option for the management of heart failure (HF) with reduced ejection fraction. However, high-quality evidence for the effect of MRAs in the treatment of heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction (HFmrEF/HFpEF) has been limited until recent years. The nonsteroidal MRA finerenone has demonstrated efficacy in this population and was approved for treatment in July 2025 by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. A call to action is needed to increase the use of guideline-directed medical therapy in HFmrEF/HFpEF with simultaneous or rapid sequence initiation of a combination therapy. This review provides an overview of MRAs approved for use in HF management, with particular focus on HFmrEF/HFpEF. Guideline recommendations and HF label indications are discussed, highlighting practical considerations for the safe use of MRAs in clinical practice. In addition, the therapeutic management of patients with HFmrEF/HFpEF and concomitant cardiovascular, kidney, and metabolic diseases is considered.
items.authors: Michos Erin D, Ambrosy Andrew P, Fonarow Gregg C
items.summary_ja: 心不全（HF）の管理におけるステロイド系および非ステロイド系ミネラルコルチコイド受容体拮抗薬（MRA）の実践的実施について概説したレビュー記事。特にHFmrEF/HFpEFにおけるMRAの使用に焦点を当て、非ステロイド系MRAフィネレノンのFDA承認（2025年7月）、ガイドライン推奨、HFラベル適応、および心血管・腎・代謝疾患を併有する患者の治療管理について論じている。
items.key_takeaway_ja: HFmrEF/HFpEFにおけるガイドライン推奨治療（GDMT）の利用率を向上させるため、併用療法の一時的または迅速な順序での開始が必要であり、フィネレノンはこの集団で有効性を示し2025年7月にFDA承認を受けた。
items.why_matters_ja: HFmrEF/HFpEFにおけるMRAの効果に関する高品質なエビデンスは近年まで限られていたが、フィネレノンの承認によりこの集団での治療選択肢が拡大し、GDMTの利用率向上に向けた行動の呼びかけが求められている。

items.title: An RNA thermogenic therapy to preserve lean mass and enhance metabolic health during GLP-1 weight loss.
items.abstract: Current obesity therapies reduce weight but often fail to preserve lean mass or sustain metabolic benefit. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) improve obesity-associated metabolic disease, but weight loss is often accompanied by reduced energy expenditure, loss of lean mass, and rapid fat-predominant regain after treatment discontinuation. We hypothesized that pharmacologic activation of adipose thermogenesis could specifically target fat loss, complement appetite suppression by increasing energy expenditure, and improve the metabolic quality of weight loss. Guided by our finding that diet-induced thermogenesis is mediated by a zinc finger protein 423 (ZFP423)-controlled pathway, we developed adipose-directed antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) targeting ZFP423, a transcriptional repressor of brown and beige adipocyte identity. In lean and diet-induced obese mice, weekly Zfp423 ASO treatment induced white adipose beiging, increased body temperature and oxygen consumption, and improved glucose homeostasis, insulin sensitivity, lipid metabolism, mitochondrial respiration, and hepatic steatosis. When combined with the GLP1-RA semaglutide, Zfp423 ASO produced greater weight and fat loss than either monotherapy while preserving lean mass and improving metabolic outcomes. These findings identify Zfp423 as an RNA therapeutic target and support adipose thermogenesis as a complementary strategy for metabolically healthier obesity treatment.
items.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
items.authors: Thorne Anneke K, Waldeck Nathan J, Rose Jesse P, Stachowski Marisa J, Guak Hannah, Keeble Alexander R, Kuusik Britta, Simon Ella
items.summary_ja: 肥満治療薬であるGLP-1受容体作動薬（GLP-1RA）は体重減少をもたらすが、痩せ体組織の維持や代謝的利点の持続には不十分である。本研究では、脂肪組織の熱産生を薬理学的に活性化することで脂肪選択的減量を実現し、GLP-1RAによる食欲抑制と相補的にエネルギー消費を増加させ、減量の代謝的質を改善する仮説を検証した。ZFP423（褐色・ベージュ脂肪細胞アイデンティティの転写抑制因子）を標的とする脂肪組織指向性アンチセンスオリゴヌクレオチド（ASO）を開発し、痩せマウスおよび食事誘発性肥満マウスで週1回のZfp423 ASO投与が白色脂肪のベージュ化、体温上昇、酸素消費量増加、グルコース恒常性・インスリン感受性・脂質代謝・ミトコンドリア呼吸・肝脂肪変性の改善をもたらすことを示した。セマグルチドとの併用では、単独療法より大きな体重・脂肪減少を達成しつつ痩せ体組織を維持し、代謝的アウトカムを改善した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: Zfp423 ASOとセマグルチドの併用は、単独療法より大きな体重・脂肪減少を達成しつつ痩せ体組織を維持し、代謝的アウトカムを改善した。
items.why_matters_ja: 現在の肥満治療薬（GLP-1RA）は体重を減少させるが、痩せ体組織の維持や治療中止後の脂肪優位の再増加の防止には不十分であり、代謝的質の高い減量を実現する補完的戦略として脂肪組織熱産生の活性化が有望であることを示した。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床研究（痩せマウスおよび食事誘発性肥満マウスを用いた動物実験）
items.endpoints_ja: 体重減少、脂肪減少、痩せ体組織の維持、体温、酸素消費量、グルコース恒常性、インスリン感受性、脂質代謝、ミトコンドリア呼吸、肝脂肪変性

items.title: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Agonist Effects on Weight Loss and Heart Failure Hemodynamics.
items.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Optimization of fluid status in heart failure (HF) is challenging. The CardioMEMS system enables real-time pulmonary artery pressure monitoring, whereas glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists offer metabolic and potential hemodynamic benefits.
CASE PRESENTATION: An 82-year-old man with HF (left ventricular ejection fraction: 40%-45%; NYHA functional class III) had recurrent decompensation despite diuretic agents. After CardioMEMS implantation, pressures remained elevated and variable. Initiation of semaglutide led to 20-pound weight loss, improved symptoms, and reduced mean pulmonary artery pressures (10 mm Hg).
DISCUSSION: This case highlights synergy between device-guided hemodynamic monitoring and GLP-1 therapy. Benefits include weight loss, improved congestion, and enhanced functional status, though caution is warranted in reduced-EF populations given mixed trial data.
CONCLUSIONS: Device-guided monitoring combined with GLP-1 therapy may enhance HF management. Further studies are needed to confirm safety, long-term outcomes, and applicability across diverse HF populations.
TAKE-HOME MESSAGE: Combining CardioMEMS with GLP-1 therapy may improve HF management through tailored, data-driven care, but patient selection remains critical.
items.authors: Alvarado Alberth, Martinez-Ponce John, Ubysz Oskar, Costa Anthony, Ataya Lina, Brancheau Daniel
items.summary_ja: 心不全（左室駆出率40-45%、NYHA機能分類III）を有する82歳男性で、利尿薬による反復する失代償に対し、CardioMEMS（肺動脈圧リアルタイムモニタリング）を植込後、セマグルチドを開始した。その結果、20ポンドの減量、症状改善、平均肺動脈圧の低下（10 mm Hg）が得られた。
items.key_takeaway_ja: CardioMEMSによるデバイスガイドの血流力学的モニタリングとGLP-1受容体作動薬の併用は、心不全管理を改善する可能性があるが、患者選択が重要である。
items.why_matters_ja: 心不全における体液状態の最適化は困難であり、GLP-1受容体作動薬は代謝的・血流力学的利益を有する可能性がある。本症例は、デバイスガイドの血流力学的モニタリングとGLP-1療法の相乗効果を提示している。

items.endpoints_ja: 体重減少、症状改善、平均肺動脈圧、うっ血、機能状態

items.title: Integrated proteomic-transcriptomic profiling identifies NR3C2 up-regulation and a candidate plasma-protein-handling signature in chronic podocyte injury.
items.abstract: The advanced stages of chronic kidney disease (CKD) are difficult to reverse, yet their protein-level pathology remains poorly defined. We analysed the kidney proteome of Pod-TRECK mice, a model of podocyte-driven CKD, at Day 14 and Day 21, representing the progression and late phases, respectively. We then integrated these proteomic data with group-average fold changes from a corresponding time-point transcriptomic dataset generated from separate cohorts of mice using the same model. Although renal function is known to worsen from Day 14 to Day 21 in this model, the bulk-kidney proteome changed only modestly over this interval. Concordance between protein and transcript fold changes also decreased, indicating that late disease progression involves protein-level changes that are not fully reflected by steady-state mRNA abundance. This late-phase signature was distributed across multiple protein groups. NR3C2, the mineralocorticoid receptor, was upregulated at the protein level without a corresponding change in transcript abundance, as further validated by immunohistochemistry. Being the pharmacological target of finerenone, NR3C2 represents a clinically relevant protein-level change that transcriptomic profiling alone would miss. A subset of plasma-derived proteins also accumulated in injured mouse kidneys without matching local transcript induction. A similar pattern was observed in human CKD kidney tissue, while related plasma proteins were reduced in patients with rapid CKD progression. Complement C5 was one prominent member of this candidate plasma-protein-handling signature. Together, these findings show that the late phase of podocyte-driven CKD involves distributed protein-level remodelling, including an RNA-discordant increase in NR3C2 protein and a candidate plasma-protein-handling signature.
items.authors: Ito Koichi, Watanabe Masaki, Kawamoto Koyuki, Kono Yuna, Sasaki Takeru, Nakagawa Ryuya, Kawashima Yusuke, Sasaki Nobuya
items.summary_ja: Pod-TRECKマウス（足細胞駆動型CKDモデル）の腎臓プロテオームをDay 14（進行期）とDay 21（後期）で解析し、別コホートで得られたトランスクリプトームデータと統合解析した。Day 14からDay 21にかけて腎機能は悪化することが知られているが、bulk腎プロテオームはこの期間でわずかな変化にとどまった。タンパク質と転写産物のfold changeの一致度は低下し、後期疾患進行にはsteady-state mRNA量では十分に反映されないタンパク質レベルの変化が関与することを示した。NR3C2（ミネラルコルチコイド受容体）は転写産物の変化を伴わずにタンパク質レベルで上昇し、免疫組織化学で検証された。また、血漿由来タンパク質の一部が局所転写誘導なしに損傷マウス腎に蓄積し、ヒトCKD腎組織でも同様のパターンが観察された。
items.key_takeaway_ja: 足細胞駆動型CKDの後期には、NR3C2タンパク質のRNA非依存性上昇や血漿タンパク質処理シグネチャーを含む、分散したタンパク質レベルのリモデリングが関与しており、トランスクリプトーム解析だけでは捉えられない。
items.why_matters_ja: NR3C2はフィネレノンの薬理学的標的であり、本結果はトランスクリプトーム解析だけでは見逃される臨床的に重要なタンパク質レベルの変化を示している。フィネレノンの作用機序の理解や、CKD進行のバイオマーカー発見に示唆を与える。
items.study_type_ja: 前臨床（動物モデル）の統合オミクス解析（プロテオミクス＋トランスクリプトミクス）。ヒトCKD腎組織での検証を含む。
items.endpoints_ja: 腎臓プロテオームの変化（Day 14 vs Day 21）、タンパク質と転写産物のfold changeの一致度、NR3C2タンパク質発現量、血漿由来タンパク質の腎内蓄積

items.title: SYVN1-mediated succinate accumulation exacerbates heart failure.
items.abstract: Metabolic remodeling, defined as changes in the energy substrate preferences and energy production efficiency of the myocardium, is one of the pathogenic characteristics of failing hearts, though its molecular mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Through untargeted metabolomics coupled with targeted mass spectrometry, we report that plasma succinate levels are significantly elevated in patients with impaired cardiac function (ejection fraction, EF<50%) compared to those with preserved EF (EF⩾50%). Succinate is a key metabolite intermediate in the tricarboxylic acid cycle. Mechanistically, we demonstrate that β-adrenergic receptor activation upregulates synoviolin 1 (SYVN1), which promotes the ubiquitination and degradation of nuclear respiratory factor 1 (NRF1). In turn, this downregulates the expression of succinate dehydrogenase complex iron sulfur subunit B (SDHB), leading to intracellular succinate accumulation and subsequent release. Furthermore, we show that the sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitor empagliflozin binds to NRF1, restores SDHB expression, normalizes succinate levels, and ameliorates cardiac dysfunction in a pressure-overload model. Our findings delineate a novel SYVN1/NRF1/SDHB-succinate axis that drives mitochondrial dysfunction in heart failure, and identify its potential as a therapeutic target for metabolic modulation.
items.authors: Cui Hongtu, Fang Lu, Cao Huanhuan, Zhan Rui, Deng Yawen, Zhao Mingming, Guo Xin, Yu Haiyi
items.summary_ja: 非標的メタボロミクスと標的質量分析により、心機能低下患者（EF<50%）ではEF保存群（EF≥50%）と比較して血漿スルシン酸レベルが有意に上昇していることを報告。機能的には、βアドレナリン受容体活性化がSYVN1を上方調節し、NRF1のユビキチン化・分解を促進、SDHB発現を下方調節し、細胞内スルシン酸の蓄積と放出を引き起こすことを示した。さらに、SGLT2阻害薬エンパグリフロジンはNRF1に結合し、SDHB発現を回復、スルシン酸レベルを正常化し、圧負荷モデルで心機能不全を改善することを示した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: SYVN1/NRF1/SDHB-スルシン酸軸が心不全におけるミトコンドリア機能不全を駆動する新規メカニズムであり、エンパグリフロジンはNRF1への結合を介してこの軸を修正し得る治療的ターゲットである。
items.why_matters_ja: 心不全の代謝リモデリングの分子メカニズムを新たに解明し、SGLT2阻害薬の心保護作用の新たな機序（NRF1結合を介したSDHB発現回復）を提示することで、代謝調節による治療戦略の根拠を提供する。
items.study_type_ja: ヒト患者を対象とした観察的メタボロミクス研究と、圧負荷モデルを用いた機能的動物実験を組み合わせた研究
items.endpoints_ja: 血漿スルシン酸レベル、心機能（EF）、SDHB発現、圧負荷モデルにおける心機能不全
items.endpoint_results_ja: EF<50%群はEF≥50%群と比較して血漿スルシン酸レベルが有意に上昇。エンパグリフロジンは圧負荷モデルでスルシン酸レベルを正常化し心機能不全を改善。具体的な数値は抄録に記載なし。

items.title: Estimating the carbon footprint of oral semaglutide (Rybelsus): a comparative analysis of the medicine carbon footprint model and manufacturer life-cycle assessment in pharmaceutical production.
items.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: Pharmaceuticals are a major contributor to healthcare's greenhouse gas emissions yet product-level carbon footprints are rarely disclosed. Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) are increasingly being used for the management of type 2 diabetes and people living with obesity, but their carbon impact remains poorly characterised. We aimed to compare carbon footprint estimates for oral semaglutide (Rybelsus), a peptide-based medicine, generated using the medicine carbon footprint (MCF) framework and manufacturer-reported life cycle assessment (LCA) data.
DESIGN AND SETTING: Comparative methodological analysis using cradle-to-gate boundaries to compare pharmaceutical carbon footprint estimates for oral semaglutide.
METHODS: Per-tablet MCF estimates for 3, 7 and 14 mg Rybelsus were annualised and compared with product-specific LCA results reported by Novo Nordisk. Differences between methods were assessed descriptively across the three dose strengths. Absolute differences and symmetric percentage differences were calculated.
RESULTS: Annualised MCF estimates were 8.9, 20.0 and 39.3 kg CO₂e/year for 3, 7 and 14 mg tablets, respectively. Corresponding EU LCA estimates were 17.0, 25.2 and 39.9 kgCO₂e/year. The mean symmetric percentage difference was -29%, with the largest discrepancy observed at the 3 mg dose (-62.6%) and the smallest difference at the 14 mg dose (-1.5%).
CONCLUSION: For oral semaglutide, MCF generated lower carbon footprint estimates than manufacturer-reported LCA values, particularly at lower doses, where fixed device/excipient and packaging emissions are proportionally larger. MCF offers a rapid, accessible and indicative estimation method when proprietary data are unavailable. Improved transparency and harmonised boundaries would strengthen comparability between pharmaceutical carbon footprint estimation approaches. These findings are specific to the Rybelsus formulation of oral semaglutide and may not be generalisable to other formulations or GLP-1 RAs.
items.authors: Hansell Louise, Zhu Wandi, Lynch Michelle, Hocking S L, Celermajer David S, Sack Fabian
items.summary_ja: 経口セマグルチド（Rybelsus）の炭素フットプリントを、医薬品炭素フットプリント（MCF）フレームワークと製造メーカー（Novo Nordisk）が報告したライフサイクルアセスメント（LCA）データを用いて比較した方法論的比較分析である。3 mg、7 mg、14 mgの各錠剤について、cradle-to-gate境界で年間換算した炭素フットプリントを算出し、両手法間の差を記述的に評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: MCFはメーカー報告LCA値よりも低い炭素フットプリント推定値を生成し、特に低用量（3 mg）で差が最大（対称パーセンテージ差-62.6%）であった。低用量では固定のデバイス・添加物・包装由来の排出が相対的に大きいためと考えられた。
items.why_matters_ja: 医薬品は医療分野の温室効果ガス排出の主要因であるが、製品レベルの炭素フットプリントはほとんど開示されていない。MCFはプロプライエタリデータが利用できない場合に迅速かつアクセス可能な推定手法を提供するが、手法間の比較可能性を高めるためには透明性の向上と境界の調和が必要である。
items.study_type_ja: 比較的方法論的分析（Comparative methodological analysis）

items.endpoint_results_ja: MCF年間推定値：3 mg 8.9 kg CO₂e/年、7 mg 20.0 kg CO₂e/年、14 mg 39.3 kg CO₂e/年。EU LCA推定値：3 mg 17.0 kg CO₂e/年、7 mg 25.2 kg CO₂e/年、14 mg 39.9 kg CO₂e/年。平均対称パーセンテージ差：-29%。最大差：3 mgで-62.6%。最小差：14 mgで-1.5%。

items.title: Evoke (+) trials of semaglutide for early alzheimer's disease: Innovations, lessons, and implications.
items.abstract: The evoke and evoke+ trials for the treatment of early Alzheimer's disease (AD) with semaglutide were founded on the observation that semaglutide reduced the incidence of dementia in patients with type 2 diabetes. Non-clinical investigations support an effect of semaglutide on AD pathology. The evoke and evoke+ trials were large, well conducted, and innovative. These trials were negative, showing no clinical benefit of treatment with 14 milligrams of semaglutide for two years. Semaglutide produced a statistically significant and robust reduction in high sensitivity C-reactive protein consistent with suppression of peripheral inflammation. There was no effect on most plasma measures collected. CSF analyses showed nominally significant effects on biomarkers of the core biology of AD; YKL-40 and glial fibrillary acidic protein in CSF were decreased indicating a reduction in astroglial activation. The magnitude of these changes was small (7%-10%) and there was no correlative effect on AD progression. The discrepancy between observations in real world data and the trial outcomes indicates that treatment of symptomatic AD confirmed with biomarkers differs from treatment of patients with diabetes who were cognitively unimpaired and at risk for all cause cognitive decline. The evoke and evoke+ trials suggest that reduction in peripheral inflammation may be insufficient to produce beneficial clinical effects in AD. The results of the evoke(+) trials do not exclude the possibility that AD populations enriched for elevated levels of markers of peripheral inflammation or use of brain penetrant GLP-1 RAs could produce therapeutic benefit.
items.journal: The journal of prevention of Alzheimer's disease
items.authors: Cummings Jeffrey L, Scheltens Philip
items.summary_ja: セマグルチドによる早期アルツハイマー病（AD）治療のEvokeおよびEvoke+試験は、2型糖尿病患者においてセマグルチドが認知症の発症を減少させたという観察に基づいて設計された。非臨床研究はセマグルチドのAD病態への効果を支持している。これらの試験は大規模で適切に実施され、革新的であったが、14mgのセマグルチドを2年間投与しても臨床的有益性は示されなかった（ネガティブ）。セマグルチドは末梢炎症の抑制と整合する高感度C反応性蛋白（hs-CRP）の統計的に有意かつ確実な減少を生じさせた。CSF解析では、ADのコア生物学のマーカーに名目上有意な効果が認められ、YKL-40とGFAPが減少しアストロサイト活性化の低下を示したが、変化の大きさは小さく（7%〜10%）、ADの進行との相関効果はなかった。
items.key_takeaway_ja: セマグルチド14mgを2年間投与しても早期AD患者における臨床的有益性は示されず、末梢炎症の減少だけではADに対する有益な臨床効果を生み出すには不十分である可能性が示唆された。
items.why_matters_ja: 2型糖尿病患者における実世界データでの認知症発症減少と、対照試験でのネガティブ結果との乖離は、バイオマーカーで確認された症状性ADの治療と、認知機能に障害のない糖尿病患者の全原因認知機能低下リスクの治療とは異なることを示唆している。また、末梢炎症マーカーの上昇で富んだAD集団や脳移行性GLP-1受容体作動薬の使用が治療的有益性を生みうる可能性は排除されていない。
items.study_type_ja: Review
items.endpoints_ja: 臨床的有益性（ADの進行）、高感度C反応性蛋白（hs-CRP）、CSF中のYKL-40、CSF中のGFAP（グリア線維酸性蛋白）、その他の血漿マーカー
items.endpoint_results_ja: セマグルチド14mgを2年間投与し臨床的有益性は認められなかった。hs-CRPは統計的に有意かつ確実な減少。CSF中のYKL-40とGFAPは減少（変化の大きさは7%〜10%）し、ADの進行との相関効果はなかった。その他の血漿マーカーには効果が認められなかった。

items.title: Cardiovascular outcomes associated With GLP-1 and dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists in patients with type 2 diabetes and inflammatory bowel disease: A retrospective real-world cohort study.
items.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Individuals with co-morbid T2D and IBD represent a uniquely high-risk group, facing amplified cardiovascular risk through synergistic inflammatory and metabolic pathways, in whom conventional cardiometabolic strategies (such as dietary and lifestyle changes, weight loss, blood pressure and lipid optimization, metformin therapy, SGLT2 inhibitor therapy) may be insufficient due to the overlap between metabolic disease and chronic inflammatory disease processes. At present, the literature available on the role of incretin-based therapy in the treatment of T2D in patients with co-morbid IBD is limited. We aimed to evaluate the association of GLP-1 receptor agonists and dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists with cardiovascular outcomes in individuals with T2DM and IBD. This study is not intended as a direct comparison of the efficacy of GLP-1 agonists and dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists in patients with T2D and IBD. Both drug classes were analyzed as a combined incretin-based therapy exposure group to reflect real-world prescribing patterns and maximize statistical power.
METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX global federated research network, identifying adults (≥18 years) with T2D and IBD between 2015-2024. Patients prescribed GLP-1 or dual GLP-1/GIP were compared with non-users following 1:1 propensity score matching on demographics, comorbidities, and medication use. Relative risks (RR) and Hazard Ratios (HR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were calculated, with significance defined as p < 0.05.
RESULTS: After matching 16,118 patients per cohort from among a total matched population of 32,236 patients, GLP-1 or GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist therapy was associated with lower hazard ratios across all outcomes, including myocardial infarction (HR 0.701, 95% CI 0.637-0.771), chronic ischemic heart disease (HR 0.936, 95% CI 0.896-0.978), heart failure (HR 0.777, 95% CI 0.737-0.820), atrial fibrillation/flutter (HR 0.838, 95% CI 0.788-0.890), sudden cardiac death (HR 0.694, 95% CI 0.605-0.795), ischemic stroke (HR 0.781, 95% CI 0.707-0.862), deep vein thrombosis (HR 0.642, 95% CI 0.586-0.702), and pulmonary embolism (HR 0.722, 95% CI 0.640-0.815).
CONCLUSIONS: In patients with comorbid T2D and IBD, GLP-1 and GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists were associated with significant reductions in ischemic, arrhythmic, and thromboembolic cardiovascular outcomes. These findings highlight the potential role of incretin-based therapies in improving cardiovascular risk management in this high-risk population. However, the present study does not establish the comparative efficacy of the two classes of drugs in this patient population, and the findings may be associational rather than causal. Both drug classes were analyzed as a combined exposure group. Mechanistic explanations proposed in this paper should be considered hypothesis-generating rather than confirmed by the current observational study design.
items.authors: Kazi Muhammad Ali Ibrahim, Mufarrih Syed Musa, Sirohi Akanksha, Hasan Fahad, Sharma Akshay, Singh Sanmeet, Muganlinskaya Nargiz, Haq Nowreen
items.summary_ja: TriNetXグローバルフェデレーション研究ネットワークを用いた後方視コホート研究。2015〜2024年に2型糖尿病（T2D）と炎症性腸疾患（IBD）を併せ持つ成人（18歳以上）を対象に、GLP-1受容体作動薬またはGLP-1/GIP二重受容体作動薬の使用者と非使用者を1:1プロパティスコアマッチングで比較し、心血管アウトカムとの関連を評価した。
items.key_takeaway_ja: T2DとIBDを併せ持つ患者において、GLP-1受容体作動薬およびGLP-1/GIP二重受容体作動薬の曝露は、虚血性、不整脈性、血栓塞栓性の心血管アウトカムの有意な減少と関連した。
items.why_matters_ja: T2DとIBDの併存は、炎症性・代謝性経路の相乗効果により心血管リスクが増幅される独自のハイリスク群を形成するが、この集団におけるインクレチン系療法の役割に関する文献は限られていた。本研究は、このハイリスク集団における心血管リスク管理にインクレチン系療法が果たしうる潜在的役割を浮き彫りにしている。
